about_item: 【Long-Lasting Battery Life】Our small battery fairy lights come with 3 pre-installed 180mAh high-capacity LR44 batteries, totaling 540mAh. Enjoy up a long time of constant lighting, perfect for decorating various items. No need to buy extra batteries like with other brands, saving you time and money. Illuminate your mason jar, vase, crafts, parties, and more with ease(Actual battery life may vary depending on usage)

【3 Lighting Modes & Brilliant Glow】Experience the magic with our fairy lights that offer 3 lighting modes - Fast Flashing, Slow Blinking, and Constant Lighting. Each mode creates a beautiful firefly effect, perfect for any occasion. Effortlessly switch between modes using the mini push switch located conveniently on the side. The compact battery box (Small Size: 1×0.6×0.4 inches) ensures discreet placement, allowing your display to shine brightly without distractions

【7ft Bendable Silver Wire】Our bulk twinkle fairy lights are crafted with a flexible silver wire that can be easily bent into any desired shape. Wrap them around photos, shelves, walls, centerpieces,mirrors, crafts, wreaths, trees, branches, plants, flowers, or use them for wedding decorations. Let your creativity shine with these versatile and enchanting light

【Safe to Touch & Waterproof】Our mini string lights prioritize safety and durability. The silver plated copper wire is designed with a high-quality 1.5V low voltage insulated line, ensuring it remains cool to touch and safe for use. Additionally, our lights are IP65 waterproof, making them suitable for humid environments and even submersible in water (excluding the battery box). Enjoy worry-free illumination wherever you need it

【Versatile and Portable】Our decor fairy lights are perfect for a wide range of decorative uses. From weddings and parties to mason jars and crafts, they are pretty & vibrant that can transform any space. Use them in bedrooms, living rooms, nurseries, or even outdoors on patios, porches, and balconies. These micro blinking lights can be taken anywhere you want to add a touch of magic. They also make a lovely gift for friends or family looking to spruce up their surroundings

summary.text: Customers find these string lights easy to set up and turn on, and appreciate their versatility for decorating small craft projects. The appearance receives positive feedback, with one customer noting they create an instant glamor and romantic atmosphere. However, the durability is concerning as they only last one day, and the battery life is poor with batteries burning up fast. Moreover, the color and brightness receive mixed reviews, with some finding them perfect while others note they're not true warm in color. Additionally, customers report that the lights get dim very quickly.

authors_reviews.title: Fairy light shopper
authors_reviews.text: I like this product of fairy light. I don’t think they will last because if you keep the lights on they become dim while using for long periods. They have 3 speeds which is constant blinking, medium blinks and stationary. The battery life which is built in last if use sporadically.
authors_reviews.author: D. Lawson

authors_reviews.title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Beautiful Fairy Lights!
authors_reviews.text: I absolutely love these fairy string lights! They add a beautiful, cozy glow to any space and create such a warm and relaxing atmosphere. They’re perfect for decorating bedrooms, patios, parties, or holiday displays. The lights look lovely and are easy to arrange wherever you want a little extra sparkle. Great for the price and a wonderful addition to my decorations. I would definitely recommend them to anyone looking to brighten up their space!
authors_reviews.author: Lynita

authors_reviews.title: good!
authors_reviews.text: smaller than expected, but overall easy to use. one or two packs started to go out after an hour of use, but could’ve been my batteries. better price than buying them at the dollar store. not tangled, and easy to manipulate.
authors_reviews.author: aspen

authors_reviews.title: Still works, but not for long.
authors_reviews.text: I had to replace batteries after 1 week even though I turned them off ever night. It takes 3 batteries each.UPDATE: Originally I had given product a 2 star review, but since customer service reached out to me to make things right, I have no problem giving 5 stars! I truly appreciate the integrity of this business and will continue to shop with them.
authors_reviews.author: M Wilson

authors_reviews.title: Not long lasting, but still cute.
authors_reviews.text: These are great, easily bends for putting them in a jar, 2 blinking modes and one stationary mode... But the battery only lasts a few days at about 2 hours each time. I guess battery can be replaced but it would be tiny hard-to-find ones. They are good for a temporary fix, but not really made for long-term use. At the price point, I think the battery life is not an issue... Fair all around. I would possibly buy them again.
authors_reviews.author: Kj White

authors_reviews.title: Excellent
authors_reviews.text: The Fairy Lights Battery Operated 7ft 20 LED Twinkle Lights are a charming addition to any space looking for a warm, inviting glow. Perfect for decorating bedrooms, patios, or special occasions, these lights offer a convenient battery-powered design, eliminating the need for nearby outlets. With three lighting modes, you can easily switch between steady, flashing, and twinkling effects to match your mood or event atmosphere.At 7 feet long, the string is just the right length to drape over furniture, wrap around plants, or highlight a mantelpiece without being overwhelming. The soft twinkle of the 20 LEDs creates a magical ambiance without being too bright or harsh. Users will appreciate the ease of use and versatility, as well as the subtle charm these lights bring to both everyday settings and festive moments.Overall, these fairy lights strike a great balance between functionality and aesthetic appeal. They are ideal for anyone wanting to add a touch of cozy sparkle without fuss or complicated setup. Whether for personal enjoyment or gifting, these twinkle lights make a delightful choice that brightens up any room beautifully.
authors_reviews.author: Sheri Lynn

authors_reviews.title: 5 of the 6 worked, very tiny lights
authors_reviews.text: Because these are so small the rainbow is harder to see. It woud have been 4 stars but one came non-working and it looks like a wire is not connected to the box. They have lasted over 6 months but are only on for about 8 hours a week, but they do add a nice sparkle. I got these from Haul so didn't pay much, but not all of them worked.

authors_reviews.title: I'll buy again
authors_reviews.text: I've used some of these in my resin pieces. They look great in them. Customers loved how they lite up.
